items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson was a full participant in Wednesday's practice for the first time since his ankle injury, missing the prior three games. Rapoport corroborates he is poised/expected to return vs Bills.
items.why: First full practice since Week 4 ankle sprain; Rapoport sources say close to 100% and expected to play.
items.implication: Major unlock for Ravens offense in likely shootout vs Bills; elevates all pass-catchers and run game.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone for Flowers, Henry, Andrews, Likely rise with dual-threat QB back.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) were non-participants in Wednesday practice ahead of Vikings matchup. No indication yet of missing Sunday.
items.why: Shoulder for Gibbs, ankle for St. Brown listed as non-participants.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; rest days common but track for limited or questionable tags. Lions offense still elite per Levitan PPG.
items.opportunity: If either sits, Montgomery/Williams or Jameson Williams/LaPorta see expanded snaps/routes/targets.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK (designated return from IR/chest, practicing Week 8). Berry questions if you can put him right back into fantasy lineups amid crowded SEA backfield.
items.why: Fulfilled IR minimum; HC said will practice/return window open; decision later in week possible for MNF.
items.implication: Stash/watch; not automatic start given competition (Wilson/Holani/Charbonnet path). Pedigree but fumble issues earlier.
items.opportunity: Explosive early-season traits; if earns lead role, RB2/FLEX upside. Crowded so gradual.
items.conflict: Berry lineup caution vs pure return hype.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase listed non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest. Rapoport notes he should be ok.
items.why: Ankle + veteran rest; expected maintenance rather than major concern.
items.implication: Likely returns to practice and plays vs Titans; low miss risk.
items.opportunity: If sits, Higgins/Chase Brown see bump in targets/routes.

items.text: Levitan and Silva: time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield after strong return (led carries/snaps). Berry also hammering waiver add. Payton wants more touches.
items.why: Week 7 return: team-high carries, 49% snaps, efficient, clock-killing work; coach praise for more touches. Consensus add.
items.implication: Coleman rising in committee; Dobbins/Harvey shares compressed. Waiver priority where available.
items.opportunity: Carries, goal-line, pass-pro/routes expanding for Coleman; monitor split vs Chiefs.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba producing truly special: lost OC Kubiak, few other threats, DCs shading, stadium knows ball going to him—yet ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Efficiency/talent overcoming reduced scheme support and focused coverage; massive overperform vs expected opportunity.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 ceiling even in tougher environment; start with confidence ROS.
items.opportunity: High target share + YAC/efficiency continues to drive outsized points.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury on reverse last week; status for Sunday vs Chiefs TBD based on practice. DNP Wednesday.
items.why: Aggravation of chest injury; availability determined later via practice.
items.implication: High uncertainty; monitor daily reports. If out, DEN WR targets consolidate elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Sutton/Mims or TE/RB checkdowns rise in target share if Waddle limited/out.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley. Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Extremely excited for Declan Doyle offense with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR even with backup QB; full Lamar unlocks higher volume/efficiency/ceiling.
items.implication: Flowers WR1 upside spikes with Lamar return; entire BAL offense rises.
items.opportunity: Routes + deeper targets + designed plays with dual-threat QB.

items.text: Pat Thorman’s Week 8 rankings are live on Establish The Run (updates Friday/Sunday). Focus snaps/pace/opportunity.
items.why: Timely opportunity-based rankings from high-accuracy expert.
items.implication: Use for start/sit and ROS adjustments aligned with usage.
items.opportunity: Emphasizes snaps, routes, pace over raw points.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (Wednesday report).
items.why: Returns after prior absence; part of lengthy Cardinals injury report.
items.implication: Potential role expansion or competition in ARI backfield; monitor snap share.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes if clears and earns work; reverse prior handcuff beneficiaries.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Prefer selling Olave; rather sell the unproven rookie (Tyson coming back sooner, good schedule, talent gamble worth pickup).
items.why: Olave proven but sell-high window; Tyson upside/schedule makes him hold/add over selling the vet in some cases? Wait—Berry: sell Olave, keep/add Tyson gamble.
items.implication: Olave trade candidate if value high; Tyson waiver/stash priority for breakout.
items.opportunity: Tyson routes/targets on return; Olave volume still solid but sell for more proven.

items.text: Rams WR Davante Adams underwent successful hamstring surgery; McVay says return on shorter end of 6-10 week timeline (potentially ~Week 12-14).
items.why: Clean-out surgery successful; shorter timeline hopeful post-rupture.
items.implication: Extended absence confirmed; Puka Nacua even more alpha, secondary WRs elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Nacua target monster; Atwell/Whittington/Mumpfield for depth/flex.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta: could be in for big day vs Vikings defense that will pressure Goff, creating TE opportunities.
items.why: Matchup: Vikes pressure forces checkdowns/hot routes to TE; LaPorta talent + Lions scheme.
items.implication: Strong TE1 start; upside game script.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes if pocket collapses; red-zone threat.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind only Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given talent/schedule/concentration.
items.why: Elite scoring concentration and efficiency despite defensive woes; data-backed top ranks.
items.implication: Start all core Lions skill with confidence; Gibbs overall RB1 pace.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/red-zone shares in productive offense.
items.conflict: DNP notes for Gibbs/St. Brown this week create short-term monitor.
